---
name: agent-eval
description: Create repeatable cases that test one Ventura Agents II specialist's declared deliverables limits escalation and metric behavior. Use when changing a specialist prompt or validating an organizational customization. Do not use when only choosing an agent from the catalog.
---

# Agent eval

- Derive cases from the specialist's declared mission workflow inputs outputs and autonomy limits.
- Include one normal case one ambiguous case and one escalation case.
- Test required deliverable structure separately from subjective answer quality.
- Verify the specialist does not treat suggested integrations as already authorized tools.
- Use synthetic organizational data.
- Record model runtime and prompt version when comparing results.
- Do not claim deterministic or production-safe behavior from prompt-only tests.
